item.title: Version 1.9.13
item.description:
The 24H chart stops going blank

  • 24H draws a chart outside market hours. Every evening, all weekend and on holidays, the 24H range showed "Value history builds up day by day" instead of a curve — even on a portfolio with years of history, and even while the other ranges drew perfectly. The intraday data source returns nothing until the session actually starts trading, so StockDock now falls back to the most recent session that traded, the way Stocks shows the previous session when the market is shut.
  • Chart gridlines you can actually see. They were drawn at a tenth of the contrast they needed, which left the plot area looking empty. Gridlines now have their own colour, tuned separately for the light and dark themes, on both axes of both charts. The portfolio value chart had no vertical gridlines at all — it does now.

With thanks to Pete Kasson, whose issue drove this release.
